alt: 孩子在安全的投球遊戲中，每次都把豆袋準確投進目標中央，旁邊的夥伴驚喜地看著。
scene_prompt: 百發百中 means every shot lands on target, demonstrating accurate skill. A modern supervised school sports-day soft beanbag tossing game, no weapons or sharp objects. Child in simple sports clothes releases one small soft beanbag toward a wide target board with ONE central round opening; its short graceful flight arc leads exactly through the center opening. A transparent collection basket immediately BEHIND that opening already contains four matching beanbags, showing previous successful shots, while ground around the target is clean with NO missed beanbags. Another child behind the throwing line watches with delighted admiration; correct two-handed anatomy, safe distance. No numbers, labels, medals, money or brand graphics.
